significance: The chief shrine of old Gurugram, honouring Kripi, also called Lalita, who is remembered for nursing children through smallpox and is worshipped as Mata Sheetla or Mata Masani. Crowds come through Navratri and the other festivals of the goddess.
story: The child of Begum Samru is said to have been cured of smallpox after being brought before the goddess here.
